purpose: Single master register for every remaining BajetBN development item before production is considered.

policy.production: LOCKED. Do not promote live until every active item in this master scope is complete, one final end-to-end staging acceptance passes, and the owner explicitly approves production.
policy.staging: The accepted v1.12 checkpoint stays unchanged while remaining development is completed on this feature branch.
policy.manualTesting: Do one final integrated staging acceptance after all development items are complete.
policy.scopeRule: A module-specific scope may never by itself be treated as full-product completion.

excluded.reason: Explicitly excluded by the owner from this development program.
